sourceText:
Simple Moist Chocolate Cake
By: Kyaora
Published: Wednesday, November 17, 2010 - 3:05am

Ingredients




 cup butter or margarine
1/4 cup caster sugar*
1 egg
1 teaspoon vanilla essence
1 tablespoon jam (cranberry, raspberry or blackberry)
1 cup flour
1 tablespoon heaped cocoa powder
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 cup buttermilk**
extra cocoa powder, icing sugar and powdered cinnamon fo

Preparation

1 Transfer mixture to a large mixing bowl and fold in flour, cocoa, soda and buttermilk.  Stir until smooth. 2 Spoon mixture into a greased loaf tin and smooth surface. 3 Bake for 35 minutes or until skewer comes out clean. 4 Leave in tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool. 5 Dust with combined cocoa powder, icing sugar and cinnamon.

About


*If, like me, you can’t get your hands on caster sugar, grind granulated sugar in the coffee grinder.  If you add a couple of vanilla pods, it make a delicious vanilla sugar to use in desserts.  You can leave the pods whole and take them out for use in puddings, they still flavour the sugar just fine.
**No buttermilk here either, so I make “mock”  buttermilk by adding 1 tablespoon of white wine vinegar to a cup of milk, stir and let stand for about 15 minutes.
